verdict.rationale: Tilled documents several onboarding paths: a no-code hosted option, an OnboardingJS library for building a custom flow, a build-your-own-UI path, merchant applications that can be pre-filled on the merchant's behalf, Plaid bank verification, and white-label hosting of the onboarding experience. The evidence never explicitly describes KYB/KYC checks, terms acceptance, or the API endpoints used to submit applications. Missing for 10: explicit KYB/KYC verification documentation, terms-of-service acceptance capture, API reference for merchant application submission, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can onboard a seller through the API — KYB and KYC, bank account linking, and terms acceptance — with hosted flows and embeddable components when I don't want to build the forms

citations.quote: No-code option for software platforms to onboard a merchant.
Build a custom onboarding flow using the OnboardingJS.
Merchant applications with the `created` or `started` status can be pre-filled and edited on behalf of the merchant.
Customize and build your own UI
Enterprise partners have the ability to host their API, merchant onboarding, and reporting console experiences on a domain that reflects their own identity
